scope: Read-only diagnosis of the single initial fixture readiness failure; no implementation tests or browser reruns performed by reviewer.

failedTest.title: an older snapshot cannot replace a newer acknowledged selection
failedTest.failure: Initial exact Select row 1 checkbox was not found by the 5000 ms toBeChecked assertion.

chronology.clock: Playwright library trace monotonic milliseconds. Network end is recorded start plus recorded duration. Test-runner timing is retained in its separate trace.
chronology.sole404: /api/plugins; explicitly fulfilled as 404 by the synthetic fixture

finding: The initial 5-second selection assertion covered asynchronous shell module loading, bootstrap, initial snapshot and rendering. The expected checkbox is correctly checked in the immediately following DOM snapshot. No selection command was dispatched before failure, so the failure does not demonstrate an acknowledged-selection ordering defect.

sourceExplanation.entryBehavior: void import(DesktopEntry).then(root.render) runs after the document load boundary; page.goto(waitUntil=load) does not wait for that dynamic import and subsequent application bootstrap.
sourceExplanation.fixtureBehavior: Synthetic API routes return the source-bound table and initial revision 1 selection. The test registers custom snapshot/save routes before navigation.
